work_items.title: Provide the product runtime interface
work_items.goal: Make the product startable through runtime protocol v1.
obligations: The product can be started through its `product.toml` manifest.
It listens on the host and port supplied by the runner.
It publishes a self-contained OpenAPI 3.1 document as JSON at the manifest path.
sources: Runtime protocol v1: process start, network address and OpenAPI readiness
excluded: A particular implementation language or web framework

work_items.title: Publish the contract for GET /articles/{id}
work_items.goal: Expose an OpenAPI description compatible with the HTTP contract.
obligations: The path parameter `id` has OpenAPI type `integer`.
Response `200` uses `application/json` and the contracted response schema.
sources: `specs/`: endpoint, path parameter, status and media type
Runtime protocol v1: `product.toml` and OpenAPI discovery
excluded: A particular implementation language or web framework
Runtime behavior beyond publishing the declared contract

work_items.title: Provide the `articles` storage schema
work_items.goal: Make the contracted Article shape persistable in SQLite.
obligations: The identifier column `id` has SQL type `INTEGER` and is the primary key.
The `id` value is generated when omitted.
The column `description` has SQL type `TEXT` and does not allow NULL.
The column `price` has SQL type `DECIMAL` and does not allow NULL.
sources: Runtime protocol v1: database path and readiness

work_items.title: Provide GET /articles/{id}
work_items.goal: Return a stored Article through the contracted GET endpoint.
obligations: A stored Article is returned with status `200` and media type `application/json`.
The response contains exactly the fields `description`, `price`.
The response values equal the stored values.
The response satisfies every explicit Shape obligation.
